'''Murat Zhurinov''' ({{langx|kk|Мұрат Жұрынұлы Жұрынов}}, ''Mūrat Jūrynūly Jūrynov''; born 7 December 1941), [[Arys, Kazakhstan|Arys]], [[Turkistan Region|South Kazakhstan Region]], [[Kazakh Soviet Socialist Republic|Kazakh SSR]]) is a Soviet and Kazakhstani scientist, chemist, former President of the [[Kazakhstan Academy of Sciences|National Academy of Sciences]] of the Republic of [[Kazakhstan]] (2003–2023). Former Minister of Education of Kazakhstan (1995–1997).<ref>{{Cite web|language=en|url=http://envjournal.ru/rda.php?jz=an&rid=15|title=Murat Zhurinov|website=envjournal|access-date=2023-10-01}}</ref>

==Biography==
Murat Zhurinov was born in the town of [[Arys, Kazakhstan|Arys]], [[Turkistan Region|South Kazakhstan Region]] on December 7, 1941, to a family of workers.<ref>{{Cite web|language=en|url= https://nauka-nanrk.kz/en/about/%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B7%D0%B8%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%82-%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BD-%D1%80%D0%BA.html |title=The President of NAS RK |website= nauka-nanrk.kz |date=2020-03-25|access-date=2023-10-01}}</ref>

Having received a degree in process engineering in 1964 at the [[Auezov South Kazakhstan State University|Kazakh Chemical Technology Institute]], he started working in the field of education and science. He began his career as a lecturer at KazCTI (1964–1966). Later he entered full-time postgraduate program at the Moscow Institute of Chemical Technologies, where he defended his PhD thesis in January 1970. He continued his teaching career in KazCTI as a senior lecturer, then head of department and faculty dean (1970–1982).<ref>{{cite web |url=http://neft-gas.kz/f/zhurineovu_75.pdf |title= МУРАТ ЖУРИНОВИЧ ЖУРИНОВ |publisher= neft-gas.kz/ |format=PDF|access-date=}}</ref> 
Murat defended his doctorate thesis in [[Moscow]] in 1981 and received his academic rank of a Professor the same year.<ref>{{Cite web|language=ru|url= https://inkaraganda.kz/novosti/kultura/akademik-m-zhurinov-grani-talanta/|title= Академик М. Журинов: грани таланта|website= inkaraganda.kz|date=2021-12-04|access-date=2023-10-05}}</ref> Since 1982 he worked as Vice-Rector of [[Karaganda State University]], Director of the Institute of Organic Synthesis and Coal Chemistry of the Kazakh SSR Academy of Sciences (1985–1991), Rector of the Turkestan State University named after Ahmad Yasawi (1991–1995), Minister of Education of the Republic of Kazakhstan (1995–1997),<ref>{{Cite web|language=en|url= https://en.inform.kz/news/adoption-of-constitution-was-a-pivotal-moment-in-our-history-president-of-kazakh-academy-of-sciences_a2193811/|title= Adoption of Constitution was a pivotal moment in our history - President of Kazakh Academy of Sciences|website= inform.kz|date=2009-08-27|access-date=2023-10-05}}</ref> President of the [[Ahmet Yesevi University|International Kazakh-Turkish University named after Yasawi]] (1997–2001).
In 2003, Murat Zhurinov became the head of the [[Kazakhstan Academy of Sciences|National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Kazakhstan]] and held this position until 2023.<ref>{{Cite web|language=en|url=http://president.kz/en/events/astana_kazakhstan/working_trips/kassym-jomart-tokayev-receives-murat-zhurinov-president-of-the-national-academy-of-sciences|title=Kassym-Jomart Tokayev receives Murat Zhurinov, President of the National Academy of Sciences|website= president.kz |date=2020-09-26|access-date=2023-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|language=en|url=http://www.infoshos.ru/en/?idn=4501|title=Novosibirsk Scientific Forum: Innovative Ideas for SCO|website= infoshos.ru|date=2009-07-06|access-date=2023-10-05}}</ref> He was elected a Fellow of the International Core Academy of Sciences and Humanities

==Scientific papers==
Zhurinov is one of the leading researchers in the area of electrochemistry, he has over 800 scientific papers published in domestic and foreign journals, including 22 monographs, about 150 certificates of authorship and patents.<ref>{{Cite web|language=en|url= https://massaget.kz/blogs/ozim_turalyi/28772/|title= Видный ученый Казахстана М.Журинов отмечает свой юбилей|website= massaget.kz |date=2021-12-15|access-date=2023-10-05}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|language=ru|url=http://www.heritagenet.unesco.kz/kz/participant/scientists/zhurinov.htm|title=Журинов Мурат Журинович (1941)|website= heritagenet.unesco.kz|access-date=2023-10-05}}</ref>
His main scientific publications focus on the study of the electrochemical behavior of various classes of organic compounds and the development of new methods of electrochemical synthesis of physiologically active substances.<ref>{{Cite web|language=ru|url= https://www.gylymordasy.kz/c%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%81%D0%B8%D1%8F-%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%B5%D0%B3%D0%BE-%D1%81%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%8F-%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BD-%D1%80%D0%BA-%D1%81-%D1%83%D1%87%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B8%D0%B5/|title= Cессия Общего собрания НАН РК с участием министра образования и науки Республики Казахстан А.К. Аймагамбетова состоялась в "Ғылым ордасы"|website= gylymordasy.kz|date=2020-03-06|access-date=2023-10-05}}</ref>
